data.text: Yes, Kate and Jack—I’ll choose 10 tons this month. My family taught me that a good catch should leave the village another good catch next month. Luke, I appreciate your offer to sit out, but I’d rather have you earning an equal share under a plan we can sustain. Let’s keep our combined catch at 50 tons while the lake is full and review the revealed catches together each month. Emma, will you join us at 10 tons? Luke, would you accept that instead of the bonus-and-recovery plan?
